hunks.baseline: In the early hours of that morning, a short post appeared on a popular forum frequently used by Hunters.
hunks.sol: In the early hours of that morning, a short post appeared on a popular forum frequented by Hunters.

hunks.baseline: > Hyungs, I had a weird dream. Can someone interpret it for me?
hunks.sol: > Guys, I had a weird dream. Can someone interpret it for me?

hunks.baseline: I can’t reveal the specifics, but I’m a member of the Security Team of a major Guild with some clout. Anyway, that part isn’t important.
hunks.sol: I can’t reveal the specifics, but I’m on the Security Team of a major Guild with some serious clout. Anyway, that part isn’t important.

hunks.baseline: I was working like usual when I nodded off for a moment. But then Lord Fuck appeared in my dream.
hunks.sol: I was working as usual when I nodded off for a moment. Then Lord Fuck appeared in my dream.

hunks.baseline: My senior said some weird guy kept hanging around, so we went to catch him together. (He’s a traitor bastard. I think his real name is probably Yamamoto, but he’s hiding it.) And that guy turned out to be Lord Fuck.
hunks.sol: My senior said some weird guy kept hanging around, so we went to catch him together. (My senior’s a traitorous bastard. I think his real name is Yamamoto, but he’s hiding it.) Anyway, the weird guy turned out to be Lord Fuck.

hunks.baseline: But that’s all I can remember clearly. After that, my senior did yutori, and I did irasshaimase.
hunks.sol: But that’s all I remember clearly. After that, my senior did yutori, and I did irasshaimase.

hunks.baseline: The post was deleted in less than ten minutes.
hunks.sol: The post was deleted less than ten minutes later.

hunks.baseline: The people who had seen it didn’t pay much attention to one attention-seeking lunatic disappearing, and no one suspected that Ares Guild had been involved in the whole sequence of events.
hunks.sol: The people who had seen it didn’t give much thought to one attention-seeking lunatic disappearing, and no one suspected that Ares Guild had intervened in the whole affair.

hunks.baseline: It was an obvious criminal act, but it would have been even more ridiculous for people who raised Black Hunters to complain about something like that.
hunks.sol: It was obviously illegal, but expecting people who raised Black Hunters to care about the law would have been even more ridiculous.

hunks.baseline: Judging by the comment about the AdultPhone disappearing, it seemed they had thoroughly checked everyone’s phones as well.
hunks.sol: Judging by the comment about the missing AdultPhone, they must have gone through everyone’s phones as well.

hunks.baseline: *That was decisive evidence.*
hunks.sol: *That recording was decisive evidence.*

hunks.baseline: My personal cameraman had bolted outside the moment Park Tae Seop and Park Jihoon appeared, and had fallen straight into Ares Guild’s hands.
hunks.sol: My personal cameraman had bolted outside the moment Park Tae Seop and Park Jihoon appeared, only to fall straight into Ares Guild’s hands.

hunks.baseline: Well, I wasn’t all that disappointed. I had been searched before leaving the building anyway. They even checked my shared cloud folder before returning it.
hunks.sol: Not that I was particularly disappointed. They had searched me before letting me leave the building anyway. They even checked my shared cloud folder before returning my phone.

hunks.baseline: “Just in case you’re hiding something, delete it now. It won’t be fun if you get caught keeping it hidden.”
hunks.sol: “Just in case you’re hiding anything, delete it now. If we catch you concealing something, it won’t be pleasant.”

hunks.baseline: I was already in a foul mood because they had discovered the porn I’d saved on my phone, and the guy’s tone had been obnoxious beyond belief.
hunks.sol: I was already in a foul mood because they had found the porn on my phone, and the guy’s tone was beyond obnoxious.

hunks.baseline: If the situation hadn’t been what it was, I would have given him one good punch.
hunks.sol: If the situation had been any different, I would have given him a good one.

hunks.baseline: He had an angular face and a crew cut. Since he had been in charge of cleaning up the situation, and everyone else had called him “Team Leader,” he seemed to be something like Lee Jungryong’s right-hand man.
hunks.sol: He had an angular face and a crew cut. He had been put in charge of the cleanup, and everyone else kept calling him “Team Leader,” so he was probably Lee Jungryong’s right-hand man.

hunks.baseline: The name Qi Sense had revealed was Go Jun. His skill had also played a part in my bothering to find out his name.
hunks.sol: Qi Sense had revealed his name as Go Jun. His skill was part of the reason I’d bothered to find out.

hunks.baseline: *That guy seemed to have learned something resembling martial arts, too.*
hunks.sol: *That bastard seemed to have learned something resembling martial arts, too.*

hunks.baseline: Once suspicion had taken root, I could see things more clearly than before.
hunks.sol: Once suspicion took root, I could see things more clearly than before.

hunks.baseline: The Ares Guild members Lee Jungryong had left behind were all extraordinary. Each one of them was skilled enough to steamroll two ordinary A-rank Hunters alone.
hunks.sol: Every Ares Guild member Lee Jungryong had left behind was exceptional. Any one of them could easily take down two ordinary A-rank Hunters alone.

hunks.baseline: But the impression I had gotten from Go Jun was… honestly, it was enough to surprise even me.
hunks.sol: But the impression Go Jun had given me was… honestly, enough to surprise even me.

hunks.baseline: The obnoxiousness in his tone came from confidence in his ability.
hunks.sol: His obnoxious manner came from confidence in his own ability.

hunks.baseline: *How did he raise people like this?*
hunks.sol: *How did Lee Jungryong train people like this?*

hunks.baseline: Could it really be martial arts? Or perhaps a martial art developed independently within Ares Guild. One question after another kept piling up.
hunks.sol: Could it really be martial arts? Or perhaps a martial art developed independently within Ares Guild.
One question led to another.

hunks.baseline: That was when I was lost in thought.
hunks.sol: I was mulling all this over when a nurse shouted from the hallway.

hunks.baseline: “Mr. Lee! Patient Im Hyeokjun is conscious!”
hunks.sol: “Dr. Lee! Patient Im Hyeokjun is conscious!”

hunks.baseline: I sprang to my feet at the nurse’s shout from the hallway outside.
hunks.sol: I sprang to my feet.

hunks.baseline: Im Hyeokjun. Im Kkeokjeong’s real name, which was almost never used.
hunks.sol: Im Hyeokjun. Im Kkeokjeong’s real name, though hardly anyone ever used it.

hunks.baseline: He had regained consciousness after three long days.
hunks.sol: After three long days, he had finally regained consciousness.

hunks.baseline: I desperately held back the urge to throw open the hospital-room door. This was the family’s time.
hunks.sol: I forced myself to resist the urge to throw open the door to his hospital room. This was time for his family.

hunks.baseline: The cries of the wife and children who had been reunited with their husband and father after three days of unconsciousness drifted through the gap beneath the door.
hunks.sol: The sobs of a wife and children reunited with their husband and father after three days of unconsciousness drifted through the crack around the door.

hunks.baseline: Only after a wave of wailing had swept through the room, and quite some time had passed, did our turn come.
hunks.sol: Only after a wave of weeping had swept through the room and quite some time had passed did our turn finally come.

hunks.baseline: Damn it. My throat tightened at his very first words.
hunks.sol: Damn it. My throat closed up at his very first words.

hunks.baseline: “Your arm, be careful! Your arm!”
hunks.sol: “Your arm! Be careful with your arm!”

hunks.baseline: “They reattached a severed arm. Did you think you’d be fine right away? Are you a person, or a transforming robot?”
hunks.sol: “They reattached a severed arm. Did you think it would be fine right away? What are you, a transforming robot?”

hunks.baseline: Song Song scolded him as she chanted a healing spell. Im Kkeokjeong’s expression relaxed considerably, as though the pain had subsided.
hunks.sol: Song Song scolded him while casting a healing spell. Once the pain subsided, Im Kkeokjeong’s expression relaxed considerably.

hunks.baseline: “If you’re grateful, please be careful. Didn’t you hear the healer? You have to rest and avoid overexerting yourself for at least two weeks.”
hunks.sol: “If you’re grateful, please be careful. Didn’t you hear the healer? You need to rest and avoid overexerting yourself for at least two weeks.”

hunks.baseline: “And thanks for saying that, too.”
hunks.sol: “And thank you for saying that, too.”

hunks.baseline: “Oh, my ears nearly fell off.”
hunks.sol: “Ow, there go my eardrums.”

hunks.baseline: I never would have imagined how happy it would make me to see him laughing heartily like a bandit.
hunks.sol: I never would have imagined how happy it could make me to see him laughing heartily like a bandit.

hunks.baseline: After bursting into the same boisterous laughter as before, Im Kkeokjeong turned to the others.
hunks.sol: After letting out the same boisterous laugh as before, Im Kkeokjeong turned to the others.

hunks.baseline: “Hyung Kim—no, Guild Master. Thank you so much. The kids’ mother told me how much you looked after me while I was unconscious.”
hunks.sol: “Hyung Kim—no, Guild Master. Thank you so much. The kids’ mother told me how well you looked after me while I was unconscious.”

hunks.baseline: “There’s no need to thank me. It was only natural. When one of our fellow Guild members suffers something like this, we have to step up.”
hunks.sol: “There’s no need to thank me. It was only natural. When one of our Guild members suffers something like this, of course we step up.”

hunks.baseline: A famous healer had been brought in to treat Im Kkeokjeong, and high-grade potions that casually cost hundreds of millions of won per bottle had been poured into him without restraint.
hunks.sol: A renowned healer had been brought in to treat Im Kkeokjeong, and high-grade potions that cost well over a hundred million won per bottle had been used without restraint.

hunks.baseline: It may have been the same in the past, but this was a world where even a human life had a price. Who would do this much for a D-rank Hunter whose only thing to show for himself was his years of experience?
hunks.sol: It might have been the same in the past, but this was a world where even a human life had a price. Who would go this far for a D-rank Hunter with nothing to his name but years of experience?

hunks.baseline: Butler Kim gave a low chuckle at Im Kkeokjeong’s voice, thick with emotion.
hunks.sol: Butler Kim chuckled softly at the emotion thickening Im Kkeokjeong’s voice.

hunks.baseline: “If you really must thank someone, thank the one footing the bill. I’m just the figurehead, so leave me out of it.”
hunks.sol: “If you really must thank someone, thank the man footing the bill. I’m just the figurehead, so leave me out of it.”

hunks.baseline: His voice was hot, as though it carried Scorching Yang Qi. Before Im Kkeokjeong could continue, Team Leader Choi cut him off.
hunks.sol: His voice burned as though it carried Scorching Yang Qi. Before Im Kkeokjeong could continue, Team Leader Choi cut him off.

hunks.baseline: “This wasn’t your fault, Mr. Im. It happened because our Guild was looked down on. I’m the one who failed to prevent this tragedy, and I’m the one who should be apologizing.”
hunks.sol: “This wasn’t your fault, Mr. Im. It happened because our Guild was looked down on. I failed to prevent it, so if anyone owes an apology, it’s me.”

hunks.baseline: Im Kkeokjeong was the sort of man who could make a hardened criminal look like a model prisoner simply by standing beside one, and now tears brimmed in his eyes.
hunks.sol: Standing next to Im Kkeokjeong was enough to make the worst thug look like a model prisoner, yet tears now brimmed in his eyes.

hunks.baseline: When he stretched out his arms to hug him, Team Leader Choi flinched and stepped back.
hunks.sol: When he reached out to embrace him, Team Leader Choi flinched and stepped back.

hunks.baseline: It didn’t seem like much of an honor, but in the end, my turn came around.
hunks.sol: It didn’t seem like much of an honor, but in the end, my turn came.

hunks.baseline: Silence descended.
hunks.sol: Silence fell.

hunks.baseline: There was something I had really wanted to say to Im Kkeokjeong once he woke up, but when I finally stood face-to-face with him, my mouth clamped shut like a clam.
hunks.sol: There was something I had desperately wanted to say to Im Kkeokjeong once he woke up, but now that I was standing face-to-face with him, my mouth clamped shut like a clam.

hunks.baseline: Im Kkeokjeong was the one who broke the silence first.
hunks.sol: Im Kkeokjeong broke the silence first.

hunks.baseline: His out-of-nowhere bragging about his family made me let out a quiet laugh.
hunks.sol: His out-of-nowhere bragging about his family drew a quiet laugh from me.

hunks.baseline: “No tree survives ten chops. Remember that. I succeeded on the forty-seventh.”
hunks.sol: “There’s no tree that won’t fall after ten chops. Remember that. I succeeded on the forty-seventh.”

hunks.baseline: “You just said no tree survives ten chops.”
hunks.sol: “You just said every tree falls after ten chops.”
Im Kkeokjeong snickered.

hunks.baseline: “There are some trees that ten chops can’t even touch.”
hunks.sol: “Turns out there are some that won’t. Ten chops didn’t even make a dent.”

hunks.baseline: “It’s a miracle you weren’t arrested.”
hunks.sol: “It’s a miracle you weren’t charged.”

hunks.baseline: Im Kkeokjeong’s wife had a puffy face from crying. She covered it with one hand and waved the other dismissively.
hunks.sol: Im Kkeokjeong’s wife, her face swollen from crying, covered it with one hand and waved the other dismissively.

hunks.baseline: A warm feeling spread from somewhere in my chest. The children’s eyes sparkled even more brightly as they looked at me.
hunks.sol: Warmth spread from somewhere deep in my chest. The children’s eyes sparkled even more brightly as they looked at me.

hunks.baseline: Children were cute and beautiful by nature, but these sisters could have been child actors. So this was the victory of maternal genes.
hunks.sol: All children were cute, but these sisters could have been child actors. This was the triumph of maternal genes.

hunks.baseline: A pleased smile formed on my face.
hunks.sol: A fond smile spread across my face.

hunks.baseline: I patted both girls on the head and said to Im Kkeokjeong,
hunks.sol: I patted both girls on the head and said to Im Kkeokjeong, “They’re adorable. So innocent.”

hunks.baseline: “They’re adorable. So innocent.”
In any case, looking at this close-knit family of four made my heart ache with emotion.
hunks.sol: In any case, the sight of this close-knit family of four made my heart swell.

hunks.baseline: Im Kkeokjeong raised his arm with stiff movements and hugged me. His hand, far weaker than before, patted my back.
hunks.sol: Im Kkeokjeong raised his arm stiffly and embraced me. His hand, far weaker than before, patted my back.

hunks.baseline: The moment I heard those words, I solidified a decision I had been carrying in my heart all along.
hunks.sol: The moment I heard those words, my resolve hardened around a decision I had been carrying all this time.

hunks.baseline: *I must not repeat the same mistake.*
hunks.sol: *I can’t make the same mistake again.*

hunks.baseline: I muttered the words inwardly and hugged Im Kkeokjeong tightly.
hunks.sol: I repeated the words to myself and hugged Im Kkeokjeong tightly.

hunks.baseline: Today was the day a man returned to the side of his family and friends.
hunks.sol: Today, one man had returned to his family and friends.

hunks.baseline: An hour later, only five Peace Guild members, including Im Kkeokjeong and me, remained in the hospital room.
hunks.sol: An hour later, only five members of the Peace Guild remained in the hospital room, including Im Kkeokjeong and me.

hunks.baseline: “I almost left my beloved wife and kids behind. I need to hear it now. Every single thing that happened, without leaving anything out.”
hunks.sol: “I almost left my beloved wife and kids behind. I need to hear it now. Everything that happened, without leaving out a single detail.”

hunks.baseline: The good-natured man who had always been softhearted and full of laughter had gained firm resolve and steel in his spine.
hunks.sol: There was a new firmness in the good-natured man who had always been softhearted and full of laughter.

hunks.baseline: After finally hearing the entire story, Im Kkeokjeong’s face had hardened.
hunks.sol: By the time he had heard the entire story, Im Kkeokjeong’s face was rigid.

hunks.baseline: “Absolutely.”
hunks.sol: “I’m sure.”

hunks.baseline: We had followed the tail called Black Hunter and found Myeongdong Guild. When we stepped on Myeongdong Guild’s torso, the head that emerged was Ares Guild.
hunks.sol: We had caught the tail of the Black Hunters and found the body called Myeongdong Guild. When we pressed down on that body, the head that emerged was Ares Guild.

hunks.baseline: The problem was that the head wasn’t an ordinary one.
hunks.sol: The problem was that this was no ordinary head.

hunks.baseline: As he said that, he cast a sidelong glance at Team Leader Choi and Butler Kim. Both of them wore their usual calm expressions.
hunks.sol: As I spoke, I glanced sidelong at Team Leader Choi and Butler Kim. Both wore the same calm expressions as always.

hunks.baseline: But I had definitely seen it.
hunks.sol: But I had seen it clearly.

hunks.baseline: Before Im Kkeokjeong regained consciousness, when they first heard the name Ares Guild, a storm had raged in the eyes of both men.
hunks.sol: Before Im Kkeokjeong regained consciousness, when I first mentioned Ares Guild, turbulent waves had surged through both men’s eyes.

hunks.baseline: I didn’t know the exact reason. Song Song and I had sensed something strange and questioned them relentlessly, but they had clamped their mouths shut after giving us the brief answer that they would tell us once Im Kkeokjeong woke up.
hunks.sol: I didn’t know exactly what. Song Song and I had sensed something strange and questioned them relentlessly, but they had clammed up after briefly saying they would tell us once Im Kkeokjeong woke up.

hunks.baseline: Perhaps he sensed Song Song’s and my gazes. Team Leader Choi was just about to open his mouth when—
hunks.sol: Perhaps he sensed our gazes. Team Leader Choi was just about to speak when—

hunks.baseline: All kinds of sounds mingled together in the hospital hallway. But their footsteps were different. They were unusually heavy, with a deep, resonant echo.
hunks.sol: Countless noises mingled in the hospital hallway, but those footsteps were different. Unusually heavy, with a deep resonance.

hunks.baseline: And there was qi.
hunks.sol: And they carried qi.

hunks.baseline: At my words, everyone rose from their seats one after another.
hunks.sol: At my words, everyone rose from their seats.

hunks.baseline: Sure enough, the footsteps stopped in front of our hospital room.
hunks.sol: Sure enough, the footsteps stopped outside our hospital room.

hunks.baseline: The door opened with the sound of a knock. A face I had seen only half a day ago appeared there.
hunks.sol: The door opened, revealing a face I had seen only half a day ago.

hunks.baseline: Wait. If that guy had come here, could it be…?
hunks.sol: Wait. If that bastard was here, then could it be…?

hunks.baseline: I couldn’t finish the thought. Go Jun’s face slipped out of sight as another man strode into the hospital room.
hunks.sol: The thought broke off. Go Jun’s face vanished from view as another man strode into the hospital room.

hunks.baseline: He was nearing seventy, yet his youthful appearance made him look like a man in his forties. He possessed the charisma of a leader and a natural air of intimidation.
hunks.sol: He was nearing seventy, yet his youthful appearance made him look like a man in his forties. He possessed a leader’s charisma and a natural air of intimidation.

hunks.baseline: His gaze swept past us before stopping dead on one person. The corner of his mouth lifted slightly.
hunks.sol: His gaze swept over us before stopping dead on one person. The corner of his mouth lifted slightly.

hunks.baseline: “You’ve grown a lot.”
hunks.sol: “You’ve grown.”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi’s gaze sank deeply as he looked at Lee Jungryong.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi’s gaze sank as he looked at Lee Jungryong.
